body: APPROVE 2bbea547acbc69963df196db096a5cee9872e970, base b020199d735386d8dc71e90865e24b4059ad7af0, for the two-file Java2D glyph-overhang repair only. No blocking code or visual findings. Java2DRenderer.scala:920-929 retains logical anchoring; :932-942 expands only the plate through logical/visual bound union and handles empty labels. TextPlateVisualSuite.scala:55 and :138 use separately rendered plate pixels as the containment oracle. Independent exact-candidate suite: 2/2 tests pass (new regression covers 90 combinations). Reviewer-owned probe adds 90 native cases including 0/33/90-degree rotations, fallback fonts and space/empty labels: candidate has zero out-of-plate ink, original renderer fails unchanged containment in 27 cases. Centre 72pt italic j reproduces 38 visible pixels outside -> 0, with 368 visible ink pixels unchanged. All 90 before/after ink planes are pixel-identical; combined outputs match independently composited planes within one ARGB unit. Six visual specimen rows and author's before/after inspected. Evidence: .agent-work/textplate-independent-review/README.md, independent-comparison.png, pixel-report.json, provenance.json and raw logs/metadata. Author-run 1860-test/full compatibility/docs evidence inspected and tested-source/build equality across rebase verified; full gates not independently rerun. Headless Java2D scale1, opaque rectangular 4px-padded plates, host logical fonts only. Broader SVG/other-backend/picking acceptance remains open. Approval does not authorize landing or close the parent ticket; claude-intaglio-motes remains authorizer. Shared main and author's checkout unchanged by reviewer.
